result.title: StochIKM: Automated High-Fidelity Reconstruction of Individual Patient Data from Published Kaplan-Meier Curves
result.summary: Individual patient data are the gold standard for secondary analysis of time-to-event evidence, but they are rarely released, and reconstruction from a published Kaplan-Meier figure could help. Existing methods all claim high fidelity, each judged by whichever agreements it happens to achieve, and each returns a single dataset although the map from figure to data is not bijective. We define fidelity explicitly: a dataset is admissible when it reproduces the risk table exactly, follows the digitized curve to within the image resolution, and respects the printed median, interval and event count. We propose StochIKM, a stochastic algorithm that digitizes the figure with a vision-capable language model and uses the high-fidelity definition as constraints, returning an admissible set of individual patient datasets. A solution is guaranteed to exist whenever the figure has been read correctly, so a failure indicts either the published figure or its digitization. In simulation and in 79 arms from published oncology trials, StochIKM reproduces the published risk tables and medians more closely than LLM-improved IPDfromKM, a high-impact alternative.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对从已发表 Kaplan-Meier 图重建个体患者数据的问题，先给出可显式检验的保真定义（精确复现风险表、曲线误差在图像分辨率内、符合印刷中位生存与事件数），再用视觉语言模型数字化图形并以这些条件为约束进行随机搜索，输出一组可接受的数据集，并在模拟与 79 个肿瘤试验组中与 IPDfromKM 变体比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「图文映射非双射、故返回多解集合，并由风险表、中位生存等外部硬约束筛选」的做法，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的生成与视觉证据一致性校验提供借鉴线索，可供核查；但 VLM 仅作数字化工具，不涉及推理状态。
